negative_reviews.author: Phil Ellis
negative_reviews.text: Sadly very disappointing. Especially considering the reviews they have. Which drew me in to prebook. This wasn't a walk in and we didn't know better. And wow... the food was really poor. Expected the food to be much better. Table service was excellent. Two staff looked after us and both were spot on and super friendly. The later staff member even removing an item from the bill as it was inedible. Food was not great. Looked insipid on arrival. No taste or real texture. Rushed and bland. Did not look anything like recent photos posted by other customers. Our table was sticky around the sides. Toilets needed a clean and the floor a mop (rather sticky) and the kitchen floors did not look clean either. Leave you doors open and public will look in. It just was sad that somewhere that had potential and such a 'bigged up website' of how they came to be and the owners philosophy fell very flat. Bad experience maybe on a bad day. 3 Nice beers for 80 quid. Real shame but wouldn't consider M&R again sadly...
